note: Starting vault for Pennyhive, a fictional savings-club app used as a test brand. Every item is invented: no real company, person, place or figure. The numbers are round and illustrative only. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Clubs on Pennyhive
vault.body: 2,000 savings clubs keep their pot on Pennyhive (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Members saving each week
vault.body: 10,000 members put money into their club every week (illustrative figure).

vault.title: Payments recorded
vault.body: 100,000 payments into clubs were recorded on Pennyhive last year (illustrative figure).

vault.title: What a savings club is
vault.body: A savings club is a group of people who each put the same amount into a shared pot on a set day. In some clubs the pot goes to one member each round, in turn, until everyone has had it once.
vault.sourceNote: General explanation written for the test brand.

vault.title: Why clubs keep records
vault.body: A club runs on trust. When every payment and every payout is written down where all members can see it, questions are settled by looking, not by arguing.
vault.sourceNote: General explanation written for the test brand.

vault.title: Free plan
vault.body: Pennyhive is free for clubs of up to 20 members.

vault.title: The shared pot
vault.body: Every member sees the club's pot, who has paid this round and whose turn it is next, on their phone.
vault.sourceNote: Product description written for the test brand.

vault.title: Payout order
vault.body: The club agrees the payout order once, at the start. Pennyhive shows it to everyone and changes it only when the whole club agrees.
vault.sourceNote: Product description written for the test brand.

vault.title: Reminders
vault.body: A gentle reminder goes out the day before a payment is due, and the club's organiser sees who still has to pay.
vault.sourceNote: Product description written for the test brand.

vault.title: Round statements
vault.body: At the end of each round every member gets a short statement: what they paid, what the pot held and who received it.
vault.sourceNote: Product description written for the test brand.

vault.title: The Thursday Club joins
vault.body: The Thursday Club, an invented club of 12 friends, moved its pot from a notebook to Pennyhive.

vault.title: Organisers' evening
vault.body: Pennyhive holds an online evening for club organisers on the first Tuesday of February (invented event).
